name: Devender & Sunita Bishnoi
quote: The soil is not an inert substrate; it is our mother that drinks the first rain.
story: Third-generation guardians of a 14-acre rainfed farm. Converted to zero synthetic chemicals in 2011.

name: Shanti Devi
farmingMethod: Dryland Rainfed Polyculture with Intercropped Pulses
quote: Millets remember when rain was scarce. They ask for nothing except our love and one monsoonal cloud.
story: Shanti leads a 60-women farmer self-help group conserving native drought-tolerant millet landraces.

name: Kattunayakan Tribal Guild
crop: Wild Forest Raw Honey & Tellicherry Pepper
quote: We never harvest the entire hive. We take only the surplus comb after the bees have reared their young.
story: Indigenous honey hunters scaling 80-foot rosewood trees without torches in the Western Ghats.

name: Master Anand & Studio Guild
farmingMethod: Local Mineral Clay Hand-throwing & Wood-ash Glazing
quote: Clay is the earth cooled down. Storing oil or grain in a clay jar allows it to breathe.
story: Anand collaborates with traditional potters to design ergonomic kitchen vessels.
